messages:
alex: Quick sync 12pm ship for newsletter + webinar benchmark. Need segmentation, send windows for NA/EU/APAC, CTA split (register vs on-demand), and inbound routing for trials. Can we lock by 4pm?

maria: In scope: TRIAL_ACTIVE_7D, TRIAL_IDLE_14_PLUS, ENTERPRISE_POC, OSS_CONTRIBUTORS; VIP list for partners. I'll generate personalization tokens.

sam: Send windows: NA 10am PT, EU 11am CET, APAC 10am SGT. Ramp 10%->50%->100% per region to reduce bounce risk.

jamie: CTA split 50/50. A/B subjects: stat-led vs case-led. I'll prepare template with dynamic tokens and fallback for on-demand.

noah: Routing rule: if clicks >=2 OR opens >3 in 48h -> tag=high_intent_webinar -> POST /sdr/webhook; else -> nurture 3-email micronudge. Opening PR to automations.

deploy-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/emails/3124010000/seed (alt text missing on hero flagged, DKIM ok).

maria: Subject variants uploaded to sheet. Recommend A/B 1 vs 2. Deliverability smoke running now.

alex: Decision: A/B 1 (stat) vs 2 (case). Seed 20k per region, winner promotes at hour 2. Jamie please drop final preview by 3:45 for signoff. Thanks team. :tada:
